description: This file defines the GetOrderDetailsHandler class, which handles requests to fetch detailed order information including order items and shipping address. It implements the IRequestHandler interface from MediatR and interacts with the order repository using specifications.

classes.name: GetOrderDetailsHandler
classes.description: Handles retrieval of detailed order information based on order ID, returning a view model for presentation.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the GetOrderDetails request by querying the order repository with a specification, then maps the result to a view model.
